summary: Statewide list entry 'bulloch 121' in Bulloch County at 161 ft; no source we found describes its build, staffing, fate or what remains today.

notes_for_editor: Two web searches, the statewide list, the Forest Lookouts Georgia index, the NHLR Georgia list and the cached county pages turned up nothing on this tower's build, staffing or fate. Only the statewide list names it, and its only note, 'aerial imagery', is unexplained. The 0.57 km (0.354 mile) distance to the airport entry is our calculation from the two coordinate pairs. The airport entry carries the code gfc-121, and this entry's name ends in 121, so the two may be one numbered record or two; no source we read settles it. The Forest Lookouts Georgia index lists a BULLOCH entry for Bulloch County with no linked page (bulloch.html returns 404). Suggested check: ask the Georgia Forestry Commission records office about record 121 and whether a tower stood on the airport field (see the us-ga-airport story).
